welcome.title: ✨ {store_name} ✨
welcome.subtitle:
Hey {name}! 👋

Welcome to your premium digital-product store. We're thrilled to have you here!

🛍️ Browse our exclusive collection
📦 Track your orders in real-time
💬 Get instant support when you need it
🎁 Enjoy special offers and rewards

Pick an option below to get started.

common.unknown_action: This action is no longer available.
common.session_expired: ⏳ This session expired — send /start to continue.
common.unauthorized: 🚫 You're not authorized to do that.
common.banned: 🚫 Your account has been suspended. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
common.error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong on our end. The team has been notified — please try again shortly.
common.flood: 🐢 You're going a bit fast — please slow down.

help.body: ❓ Help /start — main menu /products — browse the store /orders — your order history /support — get help from our team /language — change language /gift — redeem a gift code /refer — your referral link /warranty — warranty status /topup — top up your balance /profile — your account Stuck? Use 💬 Support and we'll help you out.

errors.insufficient_balance: 💳 Insufficient balance. Top up your wallet and try again.
errors.out_of_stock: 🔴 Sorry, this item just went out of stock.
errors.product_unavailable: This product is no longer available.
errors.max_per_user_reached: You've reached the purchase limit for this product.

gift.prompt: 🎁 Free Gift Have a gift code? Send it here and its value will be added to your wallet instantly. ✏️ Type your code below:
gift.default_description: Claim your free gift and add instant credit to your wallet!
gift.limit_reached: You've already claimed this gift! 😊 We'll notify you when new gifts are available.

support.menu: 💬 Support Need help with an order, a payment, or your wallet? Our team is here for you. 🎫 Create Ticket — describe your issue and we'll get back to you. 📋 My Tickets — check replies and the status of your past tickets. ⏱️ Typical reply time: within a few hours.
support.choose_category: Choose a category for your ticket:
support.created: ✅ Ticket {ticket_number} opened. Just reply here to chat with support — we'll get back to you soon.
support.created_undelivered: ⚠️ Ticket {ticket_number} was saved, but we couldn't reach our support team just now. It is not lost — we'll pick it up as soon as the connection is back.
support.left_conversation: ℹ️ That didn't go to support — you've stepped out of ticket {ticket_number}. Buttons and commands are handled by the bot, not by our team. Just send a normal message here whenever you want to continue the conversation.
support.ticket_closed: This ticket is closed. Open a new one if you still need help.
support.no_tickets: You don't have any support tickets yet.

orders.empty_history: 📦 MY ORDERS 🛍️ No purchases yet! Browse our store to find amazing products and make your first purchase today. Your orders will appear here once you buy something.
